about.title: Our Legacy
paragraphs: Shivlal Jeram Dhanawala has been crafting premium mukhwas for generations, bringing the finest traditional mouth fresheners to your table. Our recipes are perfected over decades, using only the highest quality ingredients sourced from across India.

Every batch is prepared with care, ensuring the perfect blend of flavours that awaken your senses and leave a lasting impression. We believe in preserving the authentic taste of tradition while maintaining the highest standards of quality and hygiene.
